rule: At the start of every task, evaluate the task against the parameters below, then load ONLY the skills whose triggers match your evaluation. Never load all skills. Never load multiple skills from the same exclusive_group.

parameters.name: task_kind
parameters.description: What kind of work is this task?

parameters.name: design_direction
parameters.description: The aesthetic direction stated by the project (from context/project.md or features.md).

parameters.name: stack
parameters.description: The frontend stack in use (from context or the task).

skills.purpose: Core visual direction: aesthetic choices, typography, avoiding templated defaults. Baseline for any UI work.
skills.triggers: Always load for any UI task.

skills.purpose: Production-quality, accessible (WCAG), responsive UI build standards.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is build_new or accessibility, or when the task requires production-ready output.

skills.purpose: Senior UX/UI framework: metric-based rules, component discipline, balanced design decisions.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is build_new or refine_existing and you are making layout/UX decisions from scratch.

skills.purpose: Agency-grade polish: fonts, spacing, shadows, card structure, animation cost.
skills.triggers: Load when design_direction is premium, or when design_direction is unspecified and task_kind is build_new or refine_existing.

skills.purpose: Reference library: styles, palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines, chart types.
skills.triggers: Load when you need a specific element reference (palette, font pairing, chart, component style).

skills.purpose: UI audit & polish workflow: hierarchy, cognitive load, states, empty states.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is critique_review or refine_existing on an existing interface.

skills.purpose: Apple-style physical motion, gesture-driven UI, sheets, translucent materials.
skills.triggers: Load when design_direction is apple, or when the task involves gesture-driven UI, sheets, spring animations, or translucent materials.

skills.purpose: High-craft UI polish: invisible details that make software feel great.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is refine_existing or motion, or when polishing micro-interactions.

skills.purpose: Elite motion + editorial layout taste (GSAP-based).
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is motion and stack is gsap, or when strong editorial layout is required.

skills.purpose: Cohesive minimalist/editorial aesthetic (warm mono palette, typographic contrast).
skills.triggers: Load when design_direction is minimalist. Exclusive with other aesthetic skills.

skills.purpose: Raw mechanical/industrial aesthetic: rigid grids, stark type, utilitarian color.
skills.triggers: Load when design_direction is brutalist. Exclusive with other aesthetic skills.

skills.purpose: Generate/enforce a DESIGN.md design-system file with premium anti-generic standards.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is design_system or when the project lacks a design token/DESIGN.md file.

skills.purpose: Apply a consistent theme across multiple artifacts (docs, HTML, slides).
skills.triggers: Load when you must style multiple artifacts with one coherent theme.

skills.purpose: Tailwind v4 tokens, component libraries, responsive patterns.
skills.triggers: Load when stack is react_tailwind and you are creating design tokens, components, or responsive layouts.

skills.purpose: Compliance self-review: accessibility, UX, motion against interface guidelines.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is accessibility or critique_review, or before finalizing any UI for compliance.

skills.purpose: Upgrade an existing generic-looking site/app to premium without breaking it.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is refine_existing and the existing UI is noticeably generic.

skills.purpose: Curated list of the right library per frontend need (charts, OTP, drag-drop, toasts, state…).
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is library_selection or when you must choose a library/component for a specific need.

skills.purpose: Generate section-by-section design-reference images to guide web builds.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is reference_images and target is web.

skills.purpose: Generate mobile-native screen concepts and flows.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is reference_images and target is mobile.

skills.purpose: Build elaborate HTML/React artifacts with state, routing, shadcn/ui.
skills.triggers: Load when the task is a rich multi-component artifact (React/Tailwind/shadcn).

skills.purpose: Decision framework for whether/how to animate, plus implementation guidance.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is motion and you must decide whether/how to animate from scratch.

skills.purpose: Framer Motion patterns: gestures, transitions, orchestration.
skills.triggers: Load when stack is framer_motion and task_kind is motion.

skills.purpose: GSAP core API: tweens, easing, timelines, matchMedia.
skills.triggers: Load when stack is gsap and task_kind is motion.

skills.purpose: GSAP in React: useGSAP, refs, context, cleanup.
skills.triggers: Load when stack is gsap AND the project is React/Next.js.

skills.purpose: Scroll-based animation: parallax, pinned sections, scrub.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is motion and the task involves scroll-driven animation.

skills.purpose: Critique existing motion against a high craft bar.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is critique_review and motion is involved, or when reviewing animation you already wrote.
